blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Psychological Association of the Philippines (PAP) has condemned a podcast’s discriminatory remarks about Kris Aquino’s son Josh, who is on the autism spectrum, and urged content creators to produce sensitive and ethical content. In a now-deleted podcast episode, Tito P, one of the five male hosts of “Machong Chismisan,” mocked Josh by saying “walang kwenta” (worthless) while laughing. Another host called out Tito P, describing the remark as a “low blow,” which also prompted others to laugh.
